Title: Can Allies block Nergal ADV if they have to burn blood?

Messages.Author: Matheus
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Long time ago I´ve read that, since allies do not have blood, they
could not block Nergal ADV if they have to burn one blood (to use a
raction card). But I can´t find this answer!

(Maybe it never existed! It´s only on my mind...)

Can you please help me?

Thanks
Math

Messages.Author: Ruben Feldman
Messages.Body:


IANLSJ but allies cannot play reaction cards while Nergal ADV (or
merged) is acting. They could however block him if they do not require
the help of reaction cards.

This is the same as a minion playing Tenebrous Form at superior -
allies cannot block anymore.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Right. Allies generally[1] cannot play cards that cost blood, as they
have no blood to spend to pay such a cost. This includes Delaying
Tactics, any reaction while Nergal (advanced) is acting, any reaction
while a minion with superior Tenebrous Form is acting, and so on.

[1] The exceptions are the allies that can play cards that cost blood.
Such an ability usually comes in the form of "may play cards that
require [discipline] as a vampire". These allies can pay any blood
cost to play the given class of cards with life instead of blood, per
the rules.

Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body:


Another example is Chanjelin Ward, allies can't pay the one blood to
direct an action at that vampire.
